E16.response_summary: Direct scientific specification answer (no user GeoTIFF executed). Exact Landsat 8 OLI Collection 2 Level-2 SR NDVI logic (remote-sensing-sensor-band-mappings.md, remote-sensing-indices.md, synthetic_index_calculator.py): (1) Map bands by spectral role—B4=Red (~0.64-0.67 um, 30 m), B5=NIR (~0.85-0.88 um, 30 m)—confirming C2 L2 SR metadata (Collection 1 differs: 0.0001 scale, -9999 fill, pixel_qa). (2) Mask fill (DN == 0 or source nodata) and per-pixel QA_PIXEL flags (Bit 0 Fill, Bit 1 Dilated Cloud, Bit 2 Cirrus, Bit 3 Cloud, Bit 4 Cloud Shadow, plus Bit 5 Snow/Ice as required; retain Bit 6 Clear; scene CLOUD_COVER alone is insufficient). (3) Unpack DN to surface reflectance via Reflectance = DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2 (never apply ready-made USGS index 0.0001 scaling to raw SR bands). (4) Verify B4/B5/QA_PIXEL CRS, pixel grid, and affine alignment (windowed reads for large rasters), then compute NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) with NaN/Inf and zero/near-zero denominator guards (abs(NIR + Red) < 1e-6); note C2 L2 SR can have small negative values over dark water/shadows, and NDVI in [-1, 1] is dimensionless (not % cover or universal threshold). NDWI disambiguation: McFeeters (1996) (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) [L8 B3, B5] maps open surface water (Xu 2006 MNDWI uses Green & SWIR1 B6 to suppress urban false positives), whereas Gao (1996) NDWI/NDMI (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) [L8 B5, B6] measures plant canopy liquid water/moisture.
